Name: Pusheen the Cat
Author: JamieDepledge
Description:
This mod replaces your usual cat with Pusheen the Cat, eveyone's favourite Grey Tabby! Any suggestions or requests are welcome.

How to install.
1. Backup your cat.xnb file that already exists in your \Stardew Valley\Content\Animals folder.
2. Download the file and unzip it.
3. Replace your old cat.xnb with the new one.

Obviously, this is an unofficial mod. I am not the creator or owner of Pusheen and any request from the creator to take this down will be taken seriously. I'm just a huge fan!
